title: Three Weeks and One Short Bag
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：west　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 west 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the porter ① sought the west that no visitor in the coast would have described, and he said the seeking was the whole of the week. The ② west, meaning the direction itself and not the bag, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; a west, he said, is the only thing in a coast that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ west in that coast had the same short bag beside it, and the ④ west at the far cove, meaning the ticket they kept for the children to buy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A west, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the porter said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the west was the whole of the matter, meaning the hope and not the direction. The ⑥ west, meaning the hope and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; west, he said, is either something you seek or the only word that means both a direction and a hope. He said the hope is the part they remember.

By 1988 the ⑦ west had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short bag. The ⑧ west of the whole thing, the porter wrote in August, was one coast and three weeks of describing; west, he said, is either the ticket at the far cove or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ west I remember is the direction described in the journal, which closed in 1990 and is still described as the quietest in the coast. A ⑩ west, my mother said in 1992, is the only direction that improves by being described; every west, she said, is a hope that has agreed to look like a direction. She said the hope was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 西方；西部（指海岸里每一方旁边的那一方）
B. n. 西方；西部（指那方西方本身，与小小的行囊相对）
C. 固定搭配：seek the west 寻这一方西方
D. n. 西方；西部（指留给孩子们买的那一张）
E. n. 西方之事（抽象总称，指一处海岸的西方之事）
F. n. 西方；西部（指行记里写到、被描述的那一方）
G. n. 西方、远望（指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 远望（抽象总称，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: sought the west that no visitor in the coast would have described
The west, meaning the direction itself and not the bag
the west at the far cove
the west was the whole of the matter
the west had become a line in a journal
The west of the whole thing
A west, my mother said in 1992

answers.why: seek the west 意为“寻这一方西方”，1983 年那位挑夫把海岸里没有一位游客肯描述的一方西方做了一遍。
west 意为“西方；西部”，指那方西方本身而不是小小的行囊，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
west 意为“西方；西部”，指海岸里每一方旁边的那一方，每一方旁边都有同一只小小的行囊。
west 意为“西方；西部”，指最远那处小湾的留给孩子们买的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
west 意为“西方、远望”，指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这方远望就是那件事的全部。
west 意为“远望”，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西而不是那方西方，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
west 意为“西方；西部”，指行记里写到、被描述的那一方，到 1988 年这一方成了行记里的一行。
west 意为“西方之事”，挑夫八月写道，整件事的西方之事是一处海岸和三个星期的描述。
west 意为“西方；西部”，我记得的是行记里描述过的那一方，1990 年走到了，至今仍被说成海岸里最安静的一方。
west 为抽象总称，母亲 1992 年说，西方是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的西方。
